description.value:
As part of the action used to cast this power, you must make a ranged weapon attack against a creature within your weapon's range, or the power fails. On a hit, the attack deals its normal damage, and a faint barrier surrounds the target; the first time it would take damage before the start of your next turn, that damage is reduced by 1d6.

This reduction increases to 2d6 at 5th level, 3d6 at 11th level, and 4d6 at 17th level.

system.source: PHB Ch.14 Casting — Tech Powers, At-Will
